title: ChatGPT
extract: ChatGPT is a generative AI chatbot developed by OpenAI. Originally released on November 30, 2022, the product uses large language models – specifically generative pre-trained transformers (GPTs) – to generate text, speech, and images in response to user prompts. ChatGPT accelerated the ongoing artificial intelligence boom, a period marked by rapid investment and public attention toward the field of artificial intelligence (AI). OpenAI operates the service on a freemium model. Users can interact with ChatGPT through text, audio, and image prompts.
